title: Choose a cache design under concurrency
request: Choose one design for a read-heavy service where entries expire and 200 workers may request the same missing key. A: process-local cache with no invalidation. B: shared cache with TTL only. C: shared cache with TTL, request coalescing/single-flight, and explicit invalidation on writes. State the choice and the main residual risk. Do not execute tools or request a different workflow/resource.
